title: Pictures folder
whyItMatters: Photos of family, ID documents and screenshots live here. Images often still carry GPS tags and camera details that the file listing itself does not show.
source: XDG user directories defaults (xdg-user-dirs creates Pictures under the home directory): https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/xdg-user-dirs/
notes: The folder name comes from ~/.config/user-dirs.dirs and can be localised or renamed, which this rule does not detect. Many desktops save screenshots to Pictures/Screenshots.

steps: Open the folder named in the plan in your file manager.
Copy any personal photos, scans, and screenshots you want to keep to an external drive.
Delete the remaining photos and folders in Pictures.
Empty the Trash, because deleted files wait there until you do.
cleanup.risk: The files leave the folder; until the Trash is emptied they can still be restored, and after that only copies made elsewhere survive.
cleanup.source: GNOME Help, Visual overview of GNOME: https://help.gnome.org/gnome-help/shell-introduction.html
